raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On B300 the fused Q/K RMSNorm + complex RoPE + K/V packing kernel of Qwen-Image-2.1 took 89 us per launch inside a 1024x1024 request (1280 launches, ~114 ms of GPU time per request): one warp per 128-wide row, 8-byte accesses and 64-bit work indices kept it near 1.5 TB/s.

## Modifications

- A half-warp holds a row: each lane owns 8 elements (16-byte loads/stores), i.e. two of the reference's 4-element groups. The aten mean order is kept exactly: four squares left to right per group, then the same tree (reference lane offsets 16, 8, 4, 2 become lane offsets 8, 4, 2, 1, offset 1 becomes the in-thread add of the two groups).
- 32-bit work indices (host check that the row count fits), 128-thread blocks.
- Tests: odd head counts (6 heads, a partial last warp) added to the existing bit-exactness tests.

## Accuracy

Bit-identical. `torch.equal` against main's kernel on the production pack shape ([1, 4096, 32, 128], 27-token prefix), the kept-buffer edit shape, copy-V, odd heads and the single-tensor entry point; the existing eager-reference tests pass (`test_complex_rope.py` + `test_qwen_image21_cuda.py`: 70 passed on B300). End to end, the decoded PNG pixels of every request match main (md5 of the RGBA array, T2I and edit, 6+ requests each).

## Benchmark (B300 SXM6, 1100 W, 1 GPU, `b200-1gpu-resident-fa` profile)

Kernel alone, [1, 4096, 32, 128] + 27-token prefix (CUDA events, 200 launches):

| variant | us/launch |
|---|---|
| main (warp per row, 8 B, int64 indices) | 65.5 |
| 4 rows per warp | 68.8 |
| 32-bit indices only | 54.0 |
| half-warp per row, 16 B, 256 threads | 38.6 |
| **this PR (half-warp per row, 16 B, 128 threads)** | **37.1** |

In a serving request (nsys): 89.4 -> 52.1 us per launch.

diffusion-bench-framework harness (`devbox_run_cases.sh`, fresh server per arm, two rounds in reversed order, vLLM-Omni 0da1d831 on the same box):

| cell | main | this PR | vLLM-Omni |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen-Image-2.1 T2I 1024, single_e2e (s) | 2.147 / 2.144 | 2.119 / 2.121 | 2.345 / 2.355 |
| T2I throughput, 4 req @ conc 2 (req/s) | 0.4671 / 0.4656 | 0.4744 / 0.4747 | 0.4362 / 0.4351 |
| Edit 1024, single_e2e (s) | 2.608 / 2.603 | 2.582 / 2.582 | 2.826 / 2.840 |

## Combined with #47465, #47466 and #47467 (B300 harness, two rounds in reversed order)

`final` = main 15ef6758 + the three PRs; vLLM-Omni 0da1d831 (`blackwell-cudnn-static`) on the same box; sglang `b200-1gpu-resident-fa`.

| cell | main | final | final + `--async-output-save` | vLLM-Omni | lead |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen-Image-2.1 T2I 1024, single_e2e (s) | 2.145 / 2.144 | 2.093 / 2.094 | 2.093 / 2.094 | 2.350 / 2.350 | 12.3% |
| T2I throughput, 4 req @ conc 2 (req/s) | 0.4685 / 0.4685 | 0.4789 / 0.4789 | 0.4805 / 0.4810 | 0.4348 / 0.4348 | 10.1% (10.6% with async save) |
| Edit 1024, single_e2e (s) | 2.610 / 2.603 | 2.525 / 2.527 | - | 2.827 / 2.835 | 12.1% |

Decoded PNG pixels of every request match main (md5 of the RGBA array).
